newsitem.title: UK: Surrey Free Inns to fund puchase via placing.
newsitem.headline: Surrey Free Inns to fund puchase via placing.

text.p: Licensed retailer Surrey Free Inns Plc on Monday said the funding of its 11.35 million stg purchase of Richardson Inns and Highnoon would be via a placing and open offer.
Richardsons Inns is a partnership involving leisure group Whitbread Plc and Gerald Richardson while Highnoon is controlled by the Richardson family.
Richardson is to join the board of Surrey Free Inns and will invest 1.0 million stg in its shares.
Surrey Free Inns said the placing and open offer would raise 11 million stg in addition to Richardson's subscription.
The acquisition comprises six public houses and two cafe bars. A deferred consideration of up to 450,000 stg may be payable dependent on Highnoon's profits over the next year.
Surrey Free Inns, which was admitted to the Alternative Investment Market in June 1995, said it intends to move to the official list later this year.
